audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven full-layer rows read "Skill" while content win[] read Akali/Orianna/Orianna/Akali/Akali/Akali/Akali.
audit.why: The packet levelChart matches win[] and the matchup wins 54.53% over 1779 games; the full layer was the stale copy.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side=Akali, [1..2]=Orianna, [3]=Akali, [5..6]=Akali; [4] already Akali. Proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] attributed the shield to Command: Dissonance, and wants.foe[2] wrote "Land Shockwave".
audit.why: Command: Dissonance (W) is the damage pulse plus speed/slow field. The shield is Command: Protect (E), 9s, 1095 range, and it also grants armour and magic resist. The ult's full name is Command: Shockwave — the packet flagged the near-miss.
audit.corrected: Shield credited to Command: Protect; ability named in full.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: Command: Protect is a 9-second self-shield WITH armour and MR, and Command: Shockwave launches enemies toward THE BALL, not toward Orianna.
audit.why: The shield plus resists is the only thing that survives an Akali all-in, so it, not the ult, sets the commit window. And because Shockwave resolves at the ball's position, standing away from Orianna is no protection — the ball's 410-unit circle is. Third point the page implied wrongly: Twilight Shroud's untargetability blanks none of Q, W, E or R, because Orianna commands the ball rather than selecting you.
audit.corrected: Bait Command: Protect, then commit into its 9s downtime; position off the ball rather than off Orianna; treat the shroud as concealment only.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere (sequencingCues 0), and the page tracked only the 80-110s ult.
audit.why: Her Q reaches 3s at rank 5 and her W is a flat 7s, so the lane is continuous poke; the punishable cooldown is the 9s Command: Protect, not the ult.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[2].d now key the commit to the 9s shield.

edits.before: He pokes until you shroud, then the lane belongs to the smoke — trade in obscured windows and energy-walk the rest.
edits.after: She pokes from the ball on a 3-second Q — smoke hides you but not the ball's zone, so trade only when her E shield is down.

edits.before: Survive the poke, then win every shrouded exchange until one becomes a kill. Track Command: Shockwave before every commit and keep the wave where your pattern works.
edits.after: Survive the poke, then all-in the nine seconds after Command: Protect. Track where the ball sits before every commit — that is where Shockwave drags you.

edits.before: Orianna wins by landing Command: Shockwave, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Orianna wins by chipping you with a 3-second Q, shielding through your commit, and dragging you into her team with Shockwave.

edits.before: - Orianna Command: Shockwave: matchup-defining — The fight-flipping wombo — track the ball position like a second enemy. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Twilight Shroud has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Command: Protect: 9s self-shield plus armour and MR — that is the only thing between you and her health bar, so bait it before you commit. - Command: Shockwave: 80-110s, 410 range, and it pulls you to the ball, not to her — watch where the ball sits, not where she stands.

edits.before: Carry through deletions — one carry per fight, every fight; the shroud buys the time and the resets pay the exit.
edits.after: Carry by catching her off the ball — no dash, so flank in with the E-reset and she has one shield to answer.

edits.before: If Orianna gets one kill, respect Command: Shockwave and reset to farming. Two kills: play for the team, not for solo redemption — farm with Q range and stay relevant through shroud picks.
edits.after: If Orianna gets one kill her Q lands every 3 seconds and you cannot walk the lane — farm at max Q range. Two kills: never stand grouped with an ally, and take picks only on her ball-forward mistakes.

edits.before: The fight-flipping wombo — track the ball position like a second enemy. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Shockwave launches you toward the ball, not toward her — read the ball's position and stand outside its 410-unit circle.

edits.before: Orianna wastes Command: Shockwave — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Orianna shields herself with E — nine seconds later she is naked.

edits.before: Track Orianna’s Command: Shockwave: The fight-flipping wombo — track the ball position like a second enemy. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track the ball, not Orianna: every spell she has originates there, and Shockwave launches you toward it — the shroud hides you but blocks none of it.

edits.before: Orianna's ball control and Command: Dissonance shield/slow start winning trades from level 2 through 3 before your kit fully comes online.
edits.after: Command: Dissonance slows you inside the ball's field while Command: Protect shields her, and that pair wins every trade at levels 2-3.

edits.before: Your R lets you dash past her ball zoning and burst her before she can reposition the ball for a shockwave setup.
edits.after: Your R dashes past the ball's zone and executes her — she has no dash, only a 9-second shield, to answer the commit.

edits.before: Orianna becomes a teamfight-warping threat with Shockwave, but she's still immobile without her ball nearby — flank when it's away.
edits.after: Command: Shockwave pulls a whole group to the ball from 410 range, but she stays immobile — flank from the side the ball is not on.

edits.before: Orianna: level 2 gives Orianna shield/slow value from Command: Dissonance that out-trades Akali.
edits.after: Orianna: level 2 the Command: Dissonance slow field plus her ball poke out-trades Akali.

edits.before: Land Shockwave to swing a fight or peel
edits.after: Land Command: Shockwave to swing a fight

notes: Fixed the packet's flagged near-miss ("Land Shockwave" -> "Land Command: Shockwave") and a kit misattribution: the page credited the shield to Command: Dissonance when it belongs to Command: Protect. The page also implied Twilight Shroud blanks her combo; Orianna commands the ball rather than targeting you, so it does not. Templated fields left in place for lack of an Orianna-specific fact: breakdown.wave, breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, ahead, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.late. Unverified: whether Command: Shockwave's displacement can interrupt Akali's Perfect Execution mid-dash, and whether the ball can be commanded to a target inside Twilight Shroud — neither is in Riot's text and I did not research them. | COHERENCE: 2 chart edit(s) withdrawn — they moved the row to the enemy while leaving the phase why describing the owner winning it. Chart authority is an open question, so the label was reverted rather than the prose rewritten. Re-propose only as a side+why pair.
